profile.headline: I believe in the future of agriculture.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
Building circuit and relay boards.
Creating and maintaining mobile apps for iOS, Android, and Windows Phone.
Creating and maintaining programs for Windows, Linux, and Macintosh OS.
Building industrial control systems for customers using the ControlByWeb product line.
Creating and maintaining an internal tracking system for products.

positions.title: General Laborer/Computer Technician/Administrative Professional
positions.description:
Managed and preformed all tasks related to turfgrass production, including preparing, planting, and harvesting.
Educated customers on the importance of water saving grasses.
Assisted customers in placing orders and other customer service needs.
Created and administered website, databases, and sales materials.
Setup, repaired, and maintained network and computers.

positions.title: Computer Technician
positions.description:
On-site computer analysis and diagnosis.
Computer repair and maintenance.
Delivery and pick-up of computers.

positions.title: Operator
positions.description:
Performed grounds maintenance for customers including snow removal and lawn care.
Took care of accounts receivable and accounts payable.
Created logo and business materials.
Performed all sales and customer service tasks.
